summary: release.yml gate job checkout switches to fetch-depth: 0. The v0.6.14 tag push failed the release gate solely because the pinned-commit peer-scorecard contract tests (subject_anchor.commit 832b4dfaa...) need ancestor commit objects that a default depth-1 checkout does not contain; ci.yml's gate job already uses full history for exactly this reason. No release-writer semantics, trigger, or step set changes.

components.owning_subsystem: release.yml — tag-triggered release gate + single-writer GitHub Release workflow (B11 release cadence)
components.disposition: ADMIT as a one-line environment parity fix inside the existing release gate: the gate's checkout must offer the same git object database depth as the CI gate, because the shared suite contains pinned-commit contract tests. No new workflow, no second Release writer, no gate step added or removed; the release job's checkout is untouched.
evidence: Failed run 35425174211 (Release / v0.6.14 tag): all 7 failures are tests/unit/test_peer_scorecard_v0_1.py with 'subject_anchor.commit is not a commit in this repository: 832b4dfaa...' — the pinned ancestor is absent from the depth-1 clone.
CI gate on the same tag (run 35425174219) passed with identical ruff/pyright/pytest commands; its checkout already uses fetch-depth: 0 with a comment naming the same pinned commit.
scripts/qualification/peer_scorecard_v0_1.py resolves anchors via git cat-file/show <pinned-commit>:<path>, which requires the commit object locally.
components.verification_level: Root-caused against both run logs; local A.5 self-gate; post-merge re-tag rerun of the full Release workflow is the end-to-end verification
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Checkout depth is mechanical environment provisioning; classification and release judgment stay with human review. Exit: revert the commit and the v0.6.14 tag returns to the previous (failing) gate state, no data involved.
components.rollback_route: Revert this single commit; the v0.6.14 tag object can be re-pointed back to a6008021f if needed (it has no Release attached yet).

The release gate's default depth-1 checkout cannot resolve the pinned subject commit 832b4dfaa, so every tag push would fail the gate even though the identical suite passes in CI — release cadence is blocked until the checkout depth matches.
